description: Paid (x402, 0.25 RLUSD) pre-earnings coherence gate: four paths across three data families — SEC EDGAR insider Form 4 open-market direction, SEC fails-to-deliver pressure (SqueezeOS FTD oracle), front-expiration options flow imbalance, and dealer gamma-exposure structure (flow and structure are measured from one chain snapshot = one family) — vote into the fleet coherence formula coherence = |Σ w·d| / Σ w. Verdict is PASS when consensus is non-flat, coherence >= 0.6, at least 2 paths agree, and the agreeing paths span at least 2 distinct data families; otherwise DENY. Paths that cannot answer abstain and are named in the output — they never vote. Includes a Jev (TypeSafe AI) review (status unavailable when not configured — never simulated). SHADOW posture: decision_eligible is false; the gate executes nothing.

earnings_date.description: Optional earnings print date (YYYY-MM-DD) to anchor the gate; when omitted, the next real print is read from the Finnhub earnings calendar

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AAPL, TSLA)

name: earnings_gate_verdict
returns: JSON object with ticker, earnings_date (+source), coherence, verdict (PASS | DENY), threshold, consensus, per_path_votes, abstentions, and jev_review.
